responsibility: Provides the compile-time target definition header for CRIS, supplying the macro-based GCC backend configuration that describes the architecture and ELF subtarget. It defines register numbering and names, ABI and argument-register constants, driver/CPP and cc1 specs for march/mcpu/mtune handling, assembler syntax and symbol-label output conventions, storage and common-object alignment policies, case-vector format, debugger register mappings, and many other target macros consumed by generic GCC code and the machine description.
same_name_distinction: Unlike cris.cc, cris.md, and cris.opt, this file is the CRIS target configuration header consumed at compile time: it encodes register numbers, specs, ABI/assembler, alignment, label, and debugger/dispatch-table behavior as macros and declarations, rather than implementing hooks, defining RTL instruction patterns, or declaring command-line options.
